title: C482/506/2023 of RAHUL KUMAR Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND THROUGH SECRETARY HOME, GOVERNMENT OF U.K. DERHADUN U.K.

COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
Correction Application No.04 of 2023
In
C482 No.506 of 2023
Hon 'b le Sh ar ad Ku m ar Sh ar m a, J.
Mr. Gaurav Singh, Advocate, for the
applicant.
 Mrs. Mamta Joshi, Brief Holder, for the
State of Uttarakhand.
Mr. Ravindra Singh Rawat, Advocate,
for the respondent/2.

This matter was mentioned by the
learned counsel for the applicant. Hence, taken
up out of turn.
This C482 application was allowed by
this Court by the judgment dated 17.04.2023.
Later on, learned counsel found that
certain descriptions with regards to the nature
of the offences and courts, as it has been given
in the cause title of the C482 application were
wrongly described. Hence, he filed the
correction application. The same was allowed
on 20.07.2023, and the necessary correction as
directed has been carried by him in the cause
title, and as per the correction made, therein,
the description of the Sessions Court being
issued by the court of learned Additional
District Judge/FTSC Haridwar, was introduced
along with change of Session Trial No.137 of
2020, "State Vs. Rahul" which was otherwise

described in the initial cause title of the C482
application.
Thus, amendment as permitted to be
carried in relation to the (1) the description of
the court (2) session trial number, are
accordingly directed to be incorporated in the
final order as it was rendered by this Court on
17.04.2023.
Thus, wherever Criminal Case No.90 of
2020, has been mentioned, that is directed to be
read as Sessions Trial No.137 of 2020, "State
Vs. Rahul", and wherever the court of Judicial
Magistrate, 3rd, Haridwar, has been mentioned
that would be read as Additional District Judge/
FTSC Haridwar.
This order will constitute as to be the part
of the order dated 17.04.2023.

( Sh ar ad Ku m ar Sh ar m a, J.)
 26.07.2023
NR/
